scheme_name: Marriage Grant to War Widows’ Daughters of Ex-Servicemen
other_conditions: Applicant must be the widow of an ex‑serviceman who died in the war
Applicant must be a bonafide resident of Haryana
Benefit can be availed for up to two dependent daughters
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹21,000 is provided for the marriage of each eligible daughter (up to two daughters).
